Schema:
TABLE "account" ("account_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ordinal=1, "district_id" INTEGER, "frequency" TEXT, "date" DATE)
FOREIGN KEY "account"."district_id" REFERENCES "district"."district_id" (constraint=0, ordinal=0)
TABLE "card" ("card_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ordinal=1, "disp_id" INTEGER, "type" TEXT, "issued" DATE)
FOREIGN KEY "card"."disp_id" REFERENCES "disp"."disp_id" (constraint=0, ordinal=0)

TABLE "district" ("district_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ordinal=1, "A2" TEXT, "A3" TEXT, "A4" TEXT, "A5" TEXT, "A6" TEXT, "A7" TEXT, "A8" INTEGER, "A9" INTEGER, "A10" REAL, "A11" INTEGER, "A12" REAL, "A13" REAL, "A14" INTEGER, "A15" INTEGER, "A16" INTEGER)

FOREIGN KEY "loan"."account_id" REFERENCES "account"."account_id" (constraint=0, ordinal=0)
TABLE "order" ("order_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ordinal=1, "account_id" INTEGER, "bank_to" TEXT, "account_to" INTEGER, "amount" REAL, "k_symbol" TEXT)
FOREIGN KEY "order"."account_id" REFERENCES "account"."account_id" (constraint=0, ordinal=0)

TABLE "trans" ("trans_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ordinal=1, "account_id" INTEGER, "date" DATE, "type" TEXT, "operation" TEXT, "amount" INTEGER, "balance" INTEGER, "k_symbol" TEXT, "bank" TEXT, "account" INTEGER)
FOREIGN KEY "trans"."account_id" REFERENCES "account"."account_id" (constraint=0, ordinal=0)
